scientific_synthesis: Both regime-switching models (R1 and R2) achieve superior drawdown protection compared to the unconditional static baseline (R0: 23.42% max DD). The 3-State Gaussian HMM (R1) achieves the lowest maximum drawdown (18.68%) and highest Net Sharpe (0.361) with superior regime persistence (48.2 days vs 32.5 days for R2), validating that probabilistic regime filtering delivers economic value.
